entities.name: Ysidra
entities.description: An Adarkar valkyrie who raised Vannemir from the dead to fulfill his destiny.

entities.name: Vannemir
entities.description: A warrior slain in battle and revived by Ysidra to save Terisiare from Heidar.

entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: A powerful wizard engulfed in blue fire and madness who seeks to encase the world in eternal ice.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The land threatened with destruction by Heidar.

entities.name: Knights of Stromgald
entities.description: Leaders of Heidar's army of undead soldiers.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: A realm marched on by orc and Karplusan war parties; its city Kjeld falls in the vision.

entities.name: King Darien
entities.description: A king of Kjeldor who dies in the future shown to Vannemir.

entities.name: Runeblade
entities.description: A powerful weapon bound with a Fylgja spirit, given to Vannemir by Ysidra.

entities.name: Taaveti of Kelsinko
entities.description: The man who would show Vannemir his mission.

entities.name: Guldark's orcs
entities.description: Orcs holding a girl of critical importance.

events.summary: Ysidra revives the slain Vannemir, healing all his wounds, and entrusts him with a mission to save his world.
events.quote: After Vannemir was slain in battle, Ysidra revived him, healing all his wounds

events.summary: Vannemir is shown a future in which Heidar's undead army, led by the Knights of Stromgald, destroys villages and towns.
events.quote: Heidar’s army, led by the Knights of Stromgald and composed of undead soldiers revived by necromancers, rampaged across the land

events.summary: In the vision Kjeld falls, King Darien dies and Heidar rules Terisiare in perpetual winter.
events.quote: leading to the fall of the city of Kjeld and the death of King Darien

events.summary: Vannemir chooses to return to life; Ysidra gives him the Runeblade and sends him to Taaveti of Kelsinko.
events.quote: Vannemir chose to return to the world of the living to prevent this fate.

relations.note: She revived and armed him for his mission.
relations.quote: Ysidra is the Adarkar valkyrie who raised Vannemir from the dead

relations.note: Heidar's army was led by the Knights.
relations.quote: Heidar’s army, led by the Knights of Stromgald
